about: Sifrol (pramipexole) 0.25 mg is supplied monthly from January to June 2026 beside levodopa, by brand name only.
Bromocriptine 2.5 mg tablets are supplied five times from December 2025 to April 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history that also holds levodopa.
Levodopa with carbidopa and entacapone are supplied. No dopamine agonist appears, so it must not flag.
